  • Realizar análises avançadas de rentabilidade, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e elaborar planos de ação para otimizar faturamento e margem contributiva.
  • Gerenciar temas relacionados à recuperação de créditos.

Gestão de Equipe

  • Contribuir na elaboração e análise de planos de negócios.
  • Acompanhar e apoiar o desenvolvimento das pessoas-chave da equipe.
  • Propor e implementar novos processos e iniciativas de melhoria.

Recursos Humanos

  • Participar do recrutamento e da gestão da equipe de consultores (prospecção, entrevistas, relatórios, assinatura de contratos etc.).
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de carreira da equipe (atribuição de funções, avaliações, envolvimento de talentos-chave etc.).

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, com histórico de cumprimento ou superação de metas.
  • Experiência com mercado de tecnologia.
  • Forte entendimento das técnicas de vendas e do ambiente corporativo B2B.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação.
  • Fluência em português e inglês.
  • Formação superior completa.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

O que oferecemos

  • Um ambiente internacional com oportunidades reais de crescimento.
  • A possibilidade de atuar diretamente com clientes de diferentes países (Estados Unidos e Europa).
  • Presença em São Paulo, Curitiba e Rio de Janeiro , com oportunidades de realocação entre projetos .
  • Um modelo de negócio sólido e sustentável, com crescimento anual de 52% e mais de 400 projetos ativos no Brasil .
  • Uma cultura que valoriza o acompanhamento individual, o desenvolvimento de competências e a formação contínua .
  • Uma abordagem centrada nas pessoas — sem bodyshopping , com foco em carreira e evolução profissional .

Na Amaris Consulting, promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e valorizamos a diversidade. Todas as candidaturas são consideradas sem distinção de gênero, origem, religião, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack
description:
Desenvolvedor Full-Stack

Centro - RJ | Contrato Prazo Determinado

Na Acoem Ambiental , tecnologia não é área de suporte, é área de continuidade. Aqui, cada correção, ajuste e entrega técnica garante que sistemas críticos sigam operando com estabilidade e eficiência.

Autonomia e protagonismo: espaço para atuar com independência, sempre com organização e responsabilidade.

Experiência em ambiente dinâmico: interação com diferentes áreas e desafios técnicos variados.

O que você vai fazer

Quem buscamos

  • Conhecimento em .NET Framework ou .NET Core (C#) ou Python

Habilidades necessárias

  • Boa comunicação com diferentes áreas e clientes
  • Organização e clareza na documentação (Jira, Trello ou similares)
  • Capacidade de adaptação e aprendizado rápido
  • Responsabilidade com informações sensíveis

Cuidamos de você

title: Especialista em Estratégia e Gestão de Portfólio I
description:
Descrição da vaga

SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade das informações utilizadas na tomada de decisão.
  • Conduzir a consolidação e análise de indicadores estratégicos e de performance do portfólio.
  • Apoiar e influenciar o planejamento estratégico da área, incluindo definição e acompanhamento de iniciativas e metas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em Engenharia.

Diferenciais

Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. title: Engenheiro de desenvolvimento de projetos de engenharia III
description:
SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de quatro (a) Engenheiros (Sênior) para atuar na Gerência de Estruturação de Dados Técnicos para o BPR e RTP do Sistema de Transmissão de Energia Elétrica da companhia, com foco em assegurar a consistência dos dados técnicos e regulatórios no âmbito da revisão do BPR e da RTP, a qual é fundamental para garantir os retornos dos investimentos realizados pela companhia sob responsabilidade da Vice-Presidência de Engenharia e Expansão (VEE).

Este(a) profissional será responsável por coordenar os levantamentos dos dados técnicos e memórias de cálculos para os projetos de reforços e melhorias que irão subsidiar a revisão do Banco de Preços de Referência e a Revisão Tarifária Periódica, avaliando critérios técnicos, regulatórios e econômico-financeiros, de forma a subsidiar a correta alocação e garantir os objetivos corporativos da Axia Energia.

Responsabilidades

  • Levantar dados técnicos contratuais referentes aos equipamentos por projeto (PEP), garantindo consistência entre os valores efetivamente pagos no CJI3 com as previsões contratuais.
  • Levantar dados contratuais EPCISTA’s identificando as aberturas de canteiro, montagem, engenharia, comissionamento, adm local, custos socioambientais e fundiários, custos indiretos por módulos (UAR, COM e CA) por projeto (PEP), garantindo consistência entre os valores efetivamente pagos no CJI3 com as previsões contratuais direcionadas corretamente para cada item da EAP.
  • Analisar os desvios encontrados entre os valores realizados nos projetos em cada sub-pep, com cruzamento dessas informações com as previsões constantes dos atos regulatórios.
  • Identificar as possíveis necessidades de cadastros no SGPMR/O.N.S, quando não previstas no projeto inicial, e após terem sido confirmadas pela regulação e classificadas como item extrapatrimonial, e encaminhar o levantamento para a área responsável na engenharia por esses cadastros.
  • Atuar de forma efetiva no levantamento dos dados técnicos necessários para garantir o reconhecimento dos investimentos em Transmissão pela nossa empresa, integrando dados técnicos, atos regulatórios e valores realizados no SAP.
  • Enviar as memórias de cálculo para as bases de regulação por empresa (AXIA Energia, AXIA Energia Nordeste, AXIA Energia Norte e AXIA Energia Sul.
  • Fornecer informações para o acompanhamento das alocações (MOP-Cat2 e outros contratos de suporte) nos PEP, garantindo consistência e rastreabilidade pelas rubricas canteiro, montagem, engenharia, comissionamento, adm local, custos socioambientais e fundiários, custos indiretos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Engenharia, preferencialmente elétrica e civil.
  • Experiência: Atuação prévia em empresas do setor elétrico, especialmente em planejamento, implantação de obras de reforços e melhorias de transmissão.
  • Conhecimento dos procedimentos e normativos da ANEEL e do ONS relacionados a reforços e melhorias (Módulo 2 dos Procedimentos de Rede, REN 905/2020 e correlatas).
  • Conhecimento do Módulo 9: Concessionárias de Transmissão Submódulo 9.1 REVISÃO PERIÓDICA DAS RECEITAS DAS CONCESSIONÁRIAS DE TRANSMISSÃO
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e análise de portfólio e projetos (Excel avançado, SAP, Power BI, MS Project).
  • Capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica e orientação a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com habilidade de interação com diferentes áreas técnicas e níveis hierárquicos.

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Regulação do Setor Elétrico ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de portfólio e projetos (PMI, Stage-Gate, Lean Project Management).
  • Experiência prévia em empresas transmissoras ou no ONS/ANEEL será considerado diferencial relevante.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios:

Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. Alguns dos benefícios que disponibilizamos estão disponíveis abaixo:

• Vale-refeição e vale-alimentação;

• Plano Médico e Odontológico;

• Seguro de Vida;

• Previdência Privada;

• Vale-Transporte;

• Wellhub;

• Auxílio-creche;

• Auxílio-educacional;

Se esses benefícios e essa posição fazem sentido para você, inscreva-se já!

title: Analista De Business Development
description:
Quem somos nós

Na Amaris Consulting, acreditamos que a tecnologia deve servir às pessoas — e não o contrário. Somos uma consultoria independente de tecnologia e gestão que apoia empresas em seus projetos de transformação em todo o mundo.

Gestão Financeira

  • Analisar e otimizar o Profit & Loss (P&L), calculando margens.
  • Realizar análises avançadas de rentabilidade, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e elaborar planos de ação para otimizar faturamento e margem contributiva.
  • Gerenciar temas relacionados à recuperação de créditos.

Gestão de Equipe

  • Contribuir na elaboração e análise de planos de negócios.

  • Propor e implementar novos processos e iniciativas de melhoria.

  • Participar do recrutamento e da gestão da equipe de consultores (prospecção, entrevistas, relatórios, assinatura de contratos etc.).

  • Forte entendimento das técnicas de vendas e do ambiente corporativo B2B.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação.
  • Fluência em português e inglês.
  • Formação superior completa.

O que oferecemos

  • Um ambiente internacional com oportunidades reais de crescimento.
  • A possibilidade de atuar diretamente com clientes de diferentes países (Estados Unidos e Europa).
  • Presença em São Paulo, Curitiba e Rio de Janeiro, com oportunidades de realocação entre projetos.
  • Um modelo de negócio sólido e sustentável, com crescimento anual de 52% e mais de 400 projetos ativos no Brasil.
  • Uma cultura que valoriza o acompanhamento individual, o desenvolvimento de competências e a formação contínua.
  • Uma abordagem centrada nas pessoas — sem bodyshopping, com foco em carreira e evolução profissional.

Na Amaris Consulting, promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e valorizamos a diversidade. Todas as candidaturas são consideradas sem distinção de gênero, origem, religião, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade.

100% Remoto

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Graduação completa, diploma com forte base matemática e estatística. Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado na área de ciência de dados é um diferencial.
Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL para levantamento de dados. Experiência prévia com Databricks é um diferencial.
Conhecimento avançado de Python para manipulação de dados, usando pandas e scikit-learn para treinamento de modelos de aprendizado estatístico. Conhecimento de MLOps é um diferencial.

Experiência em análise de produto: fluência com métricas de engajamento e retenção e conforto em analisar impacto de features e mudanças de jornada.

O arquiteto será o elo entre as áreas técnicas (consultores e GPs), áreas de negócio e o GDE (Gestor de Desenvolvimento Estratégico), garantindo sinergia, clareza e valor nas soluções apresentadas — desde o desenho até a entrega final.

Integração interfuncional: Estabelecer sinergia entre os times de delivery, consultores, GP e GDE, assegurando o entendimento integral da solução e seus impactos;
Elaboração da proposta final: Consolidar e apresentar a proposta técnica e comercial final, validada com o GP e o GDE;

Experiência comprovada com múltiplas soluções SAP;
Experiência comprovada em modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4 HANA, Success Factors, entre outras);
Domínio em elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais;
Familiaridade com frameworks como SAP Activate, Clean Core, Signavio, SAP BTP e Lean IX;
Capacidade de comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e executivos;
Experiência com resposta a RFPs e participação em ciclos de pré-venda;
Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e orientado a valor de negócio. Diferenciais:
Experiência com clientes enterprise e propostas de alto valor;
Atuação em ambientes híbridos com múltiplas plataformas (ex: SAP + Salesforce + Service Now); Procuramos um profissional organizado, proativo e engajado, com espírito de equipe e curiosidade para obter conhecimento do negócio. Este consultor deve trabalhar com paixão, foco e propósito, sempre buscando a excelência em suas atividades. Valorizamos a humildade e a ambição de fazer sempre mais e melhor, transformando erros e dificuldades em oportunidades de crescimento e inovação. Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, queremos conhecer você!

title: Director of studies
description:
TTA (The TEFL Academy), is the world's largest TEFL (Teaching English as a Foreign Language) teacher training company. Over 15,000 English speakers complete our TEFL qualifications each year and start exciting careers teaching English abroad or online. Our alumni are working in over 100 countries, having life changing experiences, travelling the world and improving the lives of others.
We are looking for a remote Part-Time (20hrs per week) Director of Studies to join our team. You will be responsible for academic delivery and ensure excellence in teaching, assessment, and teacher development.
You will manage the teaching team, oversee lesson quality and assessment standards, and ensure that all academic processes align with industry best practices. You'll play a critical role in teacher recruitment, training, curriculum development, and the ongoing professional development of our staff.
Key Responsibilities Academic Leadership
Provide strategic academic direction
Lead the development and continuous improvement of curricula and teaching resources
Maintain and raise academic quality standards across the programme Team Management & Development
Recruit, train, and manage a team of TEFL trainers
Mentor newly qualified trainers, providing structured onboarding and ongoing support
Deliver in-house training and CPD sessions for teaching and assessment staff
Observe and assess teacher performance, offering developmental feedback Assessment & Quality Assurance
Design, implement, and maintain clear assessment rubrics aligned with learning objectives
Monitor assessment consistency and integrity across the teaching team
Ensure timely, constructive feedback is provided to learners Operational Oversight
Allocate teaching and assessment assignments efficiently
Manage timetabling logistics in line with teacher availability and learner demand
Coordinate with internal teams (e.g. tech, admin, student support) to ensure smooth academic operations
Use IT systems (including ticket lines and online teaching platforms) to manage workflows and communication Problem-Solving & Communication
Take initiative in identifying and resolving academic or operational challenges
Communicate effectively with multiple departments to ensure alignment across functions
Adapt quickly to changing needs, especially during peak periods and across multiple time zones Requirements Essential:
TEFL qualification
DELTA or Dip TESOL qualified
Extensive experience teaching General English to adults online & in-person
Proven track record in teacher training, mentoring, and academic leadership
Experience observing and assessing teaching practices
Strong background in academic scheduling and operations
Strong digital literacy and comfort using educational platforms and IT systems
Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
Ability to problem-solve and adapt in a fast-paced, remote working environment Desirable:
Previous experience as a Director of Studies or in a similar academic leadership role
Experience managing remote teams and asynchronous workflows
Background in recruiting and managing academic staff What We Offer
A senior leadership role in a dynamic, growing international education company
Opportunities for professional development and career progression
Fully remote working arrangement
Flexible working hours, particularly during off-peak periods

Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Programa departnershipestruturado;
Treinamentos exclusivos;
Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;

Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!
O desafio
Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership, tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.
O que você vai fazer:
Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi, com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance;
Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos, conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros, incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção. O que esperamos de você:
Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
Experiência prática com AWS, especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C);
Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação com segurança da informação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
Experiência em ambientes de startup, lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos. Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início. Benefícios que oferecemos:

title: Technical ai project manager / qa lead
description:
ABOUT CONTENTJET
Content Jet is a Canadian UGC creative agency that connects brands with creators to produce high-performing user-generated content at scale. We serve global clients across e-commerce, healthcare, and marketing verticals.
Our core belief: every manual, repetitive task inside an agency can and should be replaced by an AI agent or automation. We use Claude Code CLI, Claude Cowork with MCP connectors, Open Claw, n8n, VAPI, and custom multi-agent systems to eliminate manual work across every layer of our operations — from creator sourcing and outreach to content production, team coordination, and client delivery.
THE MISSION: SHIELD OPERATIONS AND PERFECT THE AI DEPLOYMENTS
Content Jet is undergoing a massive transformation to become a fully AI-native agency. While our AI Agent Architect and Automation Engineer build the complex infrastructure, we need a ruthless tester and operational bridge.
Your mission is simple: ensure that no buggy agent, broken n8n workflow, or hallucinating AI ever reaches the CEO, our team, or our clients. You are the ultimate gatekeeper of quality and the translator between our agency operations and our engineering pod.
THE ROLE
You are the operational anchor of our AI transformation. You will not be writing the Python code or building the complex multi-agent architectures, but you must be technical enough to understand how they work, how they connect via APIs, and exactly how they break.
You will audit our existing manual operations, write clear documentation detailing exactly what the AI needs to do, and hand those requirements to the engineering team. Once they build an agent (deployed via Open Claw ) or an automation (via n8n ), your job is to try to break it. You will test every edge case, log every bug, and manage the feedback loop until the system is bulletproof and ready for the agency floor.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Audit and Document: Deep-dive into our current agency operations, mapping out every manual click, copy-paste, and email to create clear requirements for the AI Architect.
Relentless QA & Testing: Act as the \"human-in-the-loop\" during the testing phase. You will vigorously test AI agents across Slack, Monday.com, and web interfaces to find edge cases, hallucinations, and logic failures before deployment.
Bug Reporting & Triage: Manage the development pipeline. When a VAPI voice agent fails a creator screening or an n8n webhook drops data, you write the detailed bug report for the engineering team.
Prompt QA: Review the outputs of AI workflows (such as personalized creator briefs or automated emails) to ensure the tone, accuracy, and brand alignment are perfect.
Protect the CEO: Fully own the testing and troubleshooting phase so the CEO can focus purely on running the agency, completely removed from software QA.
Team Training: Once an AI agent or automation is finalized, you will write the standard operating procedures (SOPs) and train the Content Jet staff on how to use the new system. MUST-HAVE SKILLS
Exceptional QA Experience: You have a proven track record of testing complex software, automations, or AI workflows and documenting bugs clearly.
Technical Literacy: While you aren't writing production Python, you understand how APIs work, what webhooks are, and the basics of n8n and LLM prompt logic. You know why systems break.
Hyper-Organization: You are a master of project management tools (Monday.com, Jira, Linear) and can manage multiple concurrent AI deployments without dropping the ball.
UGC / Agency Understanding: You understand how a creative agency functions—what a creator brief is, how outreach works, and the level of quality clients expect.
Flawless English Communication: You will be writing detailed technical tickets, testing client-facing AI outputs, and writing internal training guides. NICE-TO-HAVE
Previous experience working in an AI startup or working directly alongside AI Engineers.
Hands-on experience with Monday.com, n8n, or testing chatbot/agent outputs.
Background in UGC, creator operations, or content production workflows.
Aligned with North American time zones (EST/PST). WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Within 30 days: You have fully audited our top 5 manual workflows, created a clear roadmap for the engineering pod, and established a formalized bug-reporting and testing system.
Within 60 days: You are rigorously testing the first wave of deployed AI agents. You have successfully caught, documented, and helped resolve critical edge cases before they impacted agency staff.
Within 90 days: You completely own the AI product lifecycle. The CEO is entirely removed from all QA and troubleshooting, and manual work across the agency is rapidly decreasing thanks to your smooth deployments.

title: Ai agent architect / builder
description:
ABOUT CONTENTJET
Content Jet is a Canadian UGC creative agency that connects brands with creators to produce high-performing user-generated content at scale. We serve global clients across e-commerce, healthcare, and marketing verticals. Our core belief: every manual, repetitive task inside an agency can and should be replaced by an AI agent or automation. We use Claude Code CLI, Claude Cowork with MCP connectors, Open Claw, n8n, VAPI, and custom multi-agent systems to eliminate manual work across every layer of our operations — from creator sourcing and outreach to content production, team coordination, and client delivery.
THE MISSION: REPLACE MANUAL WORK WITH AI AGENTS
Content Jet is on a mission to become a fully AI-native agency. That means every workflow that currently requires a human clicking, copying, pasting, searching, emailing, or following up manually should be handled by an AI agent instead. We're not looking for someone to build chatbots — we're looking for someone who can systematically identify manual bottlenecks across our operations and replace them with autonomous agent systems that run 24/7 without human intervention.
This includes: creator discovery and vetting, outreach campaign creation, brief reading and task assignment, content pipeline management, quality control, reporting, team notifications, client communication, and any repetitive operational task that currently eats human hours.
THE ROLE
You are the person who designs and builds complete AI agent systems from concept to production. You will own the architecture of multi-agent pipelines — defining agent roles, communication flows, tool integrations, and orchestration logic.
You will work extensively with Claude Code CLI to build, test, and iterate on agent systems directly from the terminal — writing production-grade code, managing project structures, and leveraging Claude's coding capabilities for rapid development. You will use Claude Cowork with MCP connectors to orchestrate complex workflows that read from Monday.com, discover creators on Tik Tok/Modash, create Instantly campaigns, produce personalized documents, and coordinate across Slack channels — all without manual intervention.
You will deploy agents via Open Claw, our open-source AI agent gateway, to make them accessible across multiple platforms (Slack, Telegram, web) with full DM and group chat support, tool management, and multi-model routing.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Systematically audit Content Jet's operations to identify every manual task that can be replaced by an AI agent or automation
Design and build multi-agent systems that fully replace manual workflows: creator sourcing, outreach, qualification, brief processing, campaign management, reporting, and team coordination
Use Claude Code CLI as your primary development environment to build, debug, and ship agent systems rapidly from the terminal
Build complex automation workflows using Claude Cowork with MCP connectors — orchestrating Monday.com, Tik Tok, Modash, Instantly, Google Drive, Slack, and other platforms into seamless, zero-touch pipelines
Deploy and configure agents via Open Claw for multi-platform delivery (Slack, Telegram, web interfaces) with DM and group chat support
Architect agent communication flows, decision trees, tool-use schemas, and escalation logic within the Open Claw gateway
Integrate agents with external tools via APIs and MCP connectors (Monday.com, Modash, Tik Tok, Instantly, Apollo, Apify, Firecrawl, Eleven Labs, Creatomate, etc.)
Build AI-powered creator sourcing and outreach pipelines — from Monday.com brief reading through creator discovery to Instantly campaign creation, with personalized Word document guides produced automatically for team members
Build AI voice agents using VAPI + Claude + Twilio/Telnyx for creator and lead qualification, replacing manual phone screening
Write production-grade Python agent code with proper error handling, logging, Slack integration (multi-channel), and monitoring
Design prompt systems at the systems level — agent instructions, Open Claw tool configurations, Claude Cowork task definitions, output parsing, and quality control
Create CLAUDE.md project files for agent codebases following enterprise-grade standards (security, design philosophy, code organization)
Continuously look for new manual processes to automate — the goal is zero manual work for repetitive tasks MUST-HAVE SKILLS
Python (production-level, not just scripting) — you write code that runs in production 24/7
Deep prompt engineering — system-level agent instructions, multi-step reasoning chains, tool-use orchestration, not simple chatbot prompts
Claude Code CLI proficiency — comfortable building, testing, and shipping entire projects from the terminal using Claude as a coding partner
Claude Cowork experience — ability to design and execute complex multi-step workflows using MCP connectors to orchestrate across platforms
Experience with Open Claw or similar AI agent gateways/orchestration frameworks for multi-platform agent deployment
API integration experience (REST, webhooks, OAuth, API chaining) — you can wire any two systems together
Experience building multi-agent or multi-step AI systems (Crew AI, Auto Gen, Lang Graph, or custom builds)
Strong understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol) — how to connect Claude to external tools, databases, and services
Understanding of agent design patterns: Re Act, tool-use, delegation, human-in-the-loop, autonomous decision-making
Experience deploying agents across multiple platforms (Slack bots, Telegram bots, web chat)
Strong English communication (written) — you'll write agent specs, workflow documentation, and team guides NICE-TO-HAVE
Familiarity with n8n (self-hosted) for workflow automation alongside agent systems
Background in UGC, creator economy, influencer marketing, or content operations
Experience with Monday.com API, Modash, Tik Tok Creator Marketplace, or similar creator tools
Experience configuring Open Claw for multi-platform deployment with tool availability management and config troubleshooting
French or Arabic language skills (for MENA market projects) WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Within 30 days: You've audited our current manual workflows, deployed your first multi-agent system via Open Claw integrated with Slack, and shipped a working creator sourcing automation using Claude Cowork with MCP connectors.
Within 60 days: You've replaced at least 3 major manual workflows with autonomous agent systems. You're independently designing agent architectures using Claude Code CLI and deploying them via Open Claw with minimal direction.
Within 90 days: You're leading AI agent delivery across 3–5 concurrent automation projects, have eliminated the majority of repetitive manual tasks in our operations, and are training team members on agent-powered workflows. Manual work at Content Jet is the exception, not the norm.

description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting Move Up Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.To be more specific, you will:Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and i Gaming innovations
Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
Has i Gaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
Ownership mindset over site and content performance
Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process ✅1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with Move Up Media
Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What’s in it for youA full time remote work environment.
A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!Move Up MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of i Gaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our approachWe focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.

title: Support specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: ). Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!About the opportunity
As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.
﻿ This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?Key Responsibilities:Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
Customer Support
Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
Documentation & Reporting
Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
Escalation Management
Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.Skills & Qualifications:Technical Expertise:
Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, mac OS, Linux) and common software applications.
Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
Problem-solving Ability:
An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
Communication Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
Organizational Skills:
Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.Preferred Experience:Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, i OS).
Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
Previous work with an American company
Education & Certifications:Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern Saa S platforms.Who You Are:
A solid technical aptitude- we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
Passion for helping others internally and externally
Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
In addition, we give bonus points for having a Saa S or Ecommerce background!

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

description:
Who we are
We’re a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Validate designs with users and iterate based on feedback
Participate in and elevate design reviews across the organization

Lead usability testing, interviews, contextual inquiry, and journey mapping
Identify unmet user needs and opportunity areas within legacy and cloud applications
Synthesize findings into actionable insights for product and engineering teams
Influence roadmap decisions through evidence-based recommendations
Establish scalable research practices within product teams
Partner with designers to validate concepts and measure experience improvements

Strong portfolio demonstrating enterprise or technical product design
Mastery of interaction and visual design
Proficiency with Figma and modern prototyping tools
Experience working in Agile environments
Familiarity with Angular or React-based systems preferred

Experience conducting research in enterprise or technical domains
Strong qualitative research skills; quantitative experience a plus
Ability to translate research into product and business impact
Experience collaborating with cross-functional product teams
For Both RolesExperience navigating complex technical environments
Strong communication and stakeholder influence skills
Comfort working in legacy systems undergoing modernization
A desire to shape and elevate UX within a global enterprise organization

title: Investment banking intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.We are activelyscreening thousands of top students globallyto identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered inpartnership with leading boutique investment banksin key markets, includingthe US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.Only two students are selected per quarterfor this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.What You'll Gain:

3-Statement Financial Modeling

Precedent Transactions

Pitch Book Development
Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research

title: Manager, corporate development
description:
Manager, Corporate DevelopmentPerseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX: CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.Location:BrazilThe Role:
The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.Outcomes:
Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.Relevant Experience & Competencies:
At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.Other Requirements:
This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U. S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Analista de relações com investidores e esg iii

title: Executive headhunter - remote

title: Encarregado de logística
description:
Dover Fueling Solutions (\"DFS\"), uma empresa Dover (NYSE: DOV) composta pelos negócios Clear View, Fairbanks, Pro Gauge, Tokheim, Wayne Fueling Systems e OPW's Fuel Management Systems, oferece equipamentos avançados de abastecimento de combustíveis, sistemas eletrônicos e pagamento, medição automática de tanques e soluções de gerenciamento de estoque de líquidos para clientes em todo o mundo. Sediada em Austin, Texas, a DFS tem uma presença global significativa, incluindo instalações nos EUA, Reino Unido, Holanda, Suécia, França, Índia, China e Brasil. Para obter mais informações, visite as atividades do setor de logística, distribuir e orientar os serviços do Almoxarifado e Revenda, abrangendo o recebimento e armazenamento de peças nacionais e importadas, garantindo a acuracidade do estoque e os devidos registros de movimentações, acompanhar as atividades de expedição de peças e produtos acabados para o mercado interno e exportação, controlar todo o fluxo do processo de armazenagem dos armazéns internos e externos, coordenar as atividades de separação, embalagem e envio de peças e produtos de automação e intercompany, e processos de reparos eletrônicos com o objetivo de garantir a reposição de peças em campo e buscar soluções para eventuais problemas que possam ocorrer.Responsabilidades definidas para o Encarregado do setor de almoxarifado:Supervisionar a contagem cíclica e acompanhar as devidas análises bem como, tratativas das divergências quando necessário.
Gerir a equipe em todos os processos de desenvolvimento, treinamento de procedimentos/instruções de trabalho, assim como realizar manutenção de apontamento de ponto, programação de férias via sistema de Administração de Pessoal;
Prezar pelas condições de segurança de sua equipe no seu âmbito de atuação, atendendo aos requisitos legais da empresa, acompanhando uso e validade dos equipamentos, visando garantir o cumprimento de normas e exigências legais e da empresa;
Acompanhar as rotinas de recebimento e programar junto ao time de compras os recebimentos diários, a fim de adequar a capacidade de recebimento a demanda;
Garantir a gestão do fluxo de recebimento e armazenamento de materiais, garantindo acuracidade da conferência, movimentação física e sistêmica dos itens recebidos, e eliminar divergências de estoque e ajustes financeiros desnecessários;
Analisar junto ao time de Sourcing e Qualidade o melhor tipo de embalagem para os produtos recebidos a fim de garantir o melhor uso de espaço do armazém, facilitando assim a conferência, armazenagem e garantindo a conservação do produto durante o transporte e no armazém;
Informar diariamente a diretoria, área de vendas, suporte a cliente, planejamento de materiais, produção e setores envolvidos sobre o nível de estoque de produto acabado e solicitar / controlar Ordens de Pagamentos (POs) referentes aos pagamentos de fornecedores de fretes;
Participar de reuniões com a área de planejamento referente a programação de produção dos pedidos de revenda e monitorar estoque/itens em almoxarifado de peças fora de linha;
Garantir a continuidade do programa 5 S, ou similar, nas áreas sob sua responsabilidade;
Executar outras tarefas correlatas a critério do superior imediato.Responsabilidades definidas para o Encarregado do setor de Revenda
Gerir a equipe em todos os processos de desenvolvimento, treinamento de procedimentos/instruções de trabalho, assim como realizar manutenção de apontamento de ponto, programação de férias via sistema de Administração de Pessoal;

Identificar necessidades prioritárias de expedição de produtos acabados, coordenar a movimentação, armazenamento e organização dos materiais a serem expedidos, e coordenar todo o fluxo de saldos de produtos acabados internamente e em armazéns externos.

title: Analista de governança microsoft pleno | senior
description:
Analista de Governança Microsoft - Pleno / Sênior
Missão
Atuar como referência de governança e sustentação técnica (nível N3) para o ecossistema Microsoft, garantindo estabilidade, segurança, conformidade e controle de custos principalmente em Power Platform, Share Point Online e Copilot Studio. A posição combina administração de plataforma com capacidade prática de construção e troubleshooting de soluções low-code e agentes.
A administração e governança desses produtos é centralizada nos centros de administração (Power Platform Admin Center etc.) e envolve proteger dados, controlar acessos e monitorar o que makers/usuários fazem.
Escopo de atuação
Microsoft (Power Platform, Dataverse, Share Point Online, M365/Entra, Copilot Studio)
Administração pontual / governança leve de plataformas de IA corporativa (Gemini Enterprise, Open AI Enterprise, Notebook LM) (ex.: gestão de acessos, onboarding, padrões e controles básicos)
Requisitos
1) Administração e Sustentação da Plataforma (N3)
Administrar ambientes (criação, padronização, saneamento, controle de capacidade e permissões), garantindo operação estável e previsível.
Executar rotinas de manutenção, saneamento e ajustes técnicos (ex.: ambientes órfãos, owners, conectores, políticas, agentes e automações fora de padrão).
Definir e manter runbooks e procedimentos operacionais para incidentes recorrentes e auditorias.
2) Governança e Segurança (Power Platform + Copilot Studio + M365)
Implementar e operar políticas de governança: DLP, segmentação de conectores (Business/Non-Business), padrões de ambientes e critérios de publicação.
Garantir aderência a controles de Copilot Studio (ex.: data policies, autenticação, conectores/ações, roteamento de ambientes, logs e rastreabilidade).
3) Desenvolvimento e Troubleshooting (N3 Maker) — obrigatório
Desenvolver e dar suporte avançado (N3) em: Agentes no Copilot Studio (conectores, knowledge sources, autenticação, governança de publicação e segurança).
Power Apps (Canvas e/ou Model-driven conforme necessidade) e Power Automate (cloud flows, integrações e automações administrativas).
Diagnosticar incidentes complexos de makers/ambientes (erros de permissão, conectores, falhas de execução, limites/capacidade, problemas de DLP e ALM).
4) Administração do Dataverse (capacidade, saúde e KPIs)
Administrar o Dataverse garantindo utilização dentro de KPIs (capacidade, performance, organização e governança do inventário).
Monitorar e corrigir causas de degradação (crescimento descontrolado, ambientes mal configurados, automações etc.).
Apoiar governança de dados/entidades relevantes ao Co E e relatórios operacionais.
5) Gestão de custos e sustentabilidade financeira
Controlar e reportar custos e consumo de: Power Apps / Power Automate
Copilot Studio (agentes)
Propor medidas de otimização (racionalização de ambientes, consolidação/arquivamento, revisão de owners/licenças, desativação de ativos sem uso, melhoria de governança de conectores)
6) Operação do Co E (Power Platform + Copilot Studio)
Administrar e evoluir o Centro de Excelência (Co E): inventário, auditoria operacional, padrões, dashboards e rotinas automatizadas de governança.
Monitorar automações administrativas do Co E e garantirexecução/observabilidade.
Suportar a organização com orientações de governança e boas práticas (makers, owners, champions e times low-code).
7) Share Point Online (governança e sustentação)
Atuar em governança de Share Point Online (estrutura, acessos, padrões de armazenamento, higiene/organização e integração com soluções Power Platform/Copilot)
Requisitos obrigatórios
Experiência prática com administração e governança do Power Platform (ambientes, DLP, conectores, capacidade, troubleshooting).
Conhecimento sólido de licenciamento e segurança no ecossistema Power Platform + M365.
Capacidade de desenvolver: Agentes no Copilot Studio (incluindo conectores/ações e governança)
Power Apps e Power Automate (para ser N3 de desenvolvimento e plataforma)
Vivência com Dataverse (administração, organização e sustentação operacional).
Experiência com Share Point Online (admin/governança básica a intermediária e integrações).
Diferenciais (nice to have)
Experiência com Co E Starter Kit e práticas de adoção/governança em escala.
Conhecimento de logs/auditoria (Purview/Sentinel) aplicados a Copilot Studio e governança.
Noções de ALM / padrões / RACI para governança e operação de plataformas low-code.
Vivência com governança básica/gestão de acessos em Gemini Enterprise / Open AI Enterprise / Notebook LM (menor demanda).

title: Ugc content creator (freelance)
description:
About the CompanyWe are a fast-growing global mobile app company building digital products used by millions of people worldwide. Our focus is on creating scalable, data-driven consumer applications that combine creativity, technology, and performance marketing.Role Overview
Produce high-quality 30–60 second short-form videos for Tik Tok and Instagram, promoting consumer-focused mobile applications to global audiences.
Translate creative briefs into compelling, performance-oriented content while also bringing fresh, original ideas to the table.
Develop powerful hooks, relatable scenarios, and innovative use cases that capture attention within the first seconds.
Continuously research trends, viral formats, and competitor strategies to keep content relevant and competitive.
Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to align content with growth goals, campaign strategy, and performance metrics.
Share learnings and creative suggestions that help improve overall content strategy, engagement rates, and conversion performance.Candidate Profile
Strong interest in Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, and short-form content ecosystems.
Ability to create engaging, high-retention videos that align with platform trends (portfolio or sample work is highly preferred).
Strong creative instinct with the ability to turn everyday concepts into attention-grabbing content.
Confidence on camera — or strong storytelling ability without appearing on camera.

title: Assembly And After-Sales Support Technician
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician

Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required

Reports to: Account Manager and CTO

Contract Type: CLT

About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.

Position Summary:

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

Position duties and responsibilities:

  • Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
  • Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
  • Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
  • Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.

Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
  • Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.

Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.

LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.

Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:

  • Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician .
  • Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English .
  • Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
  • Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

title: Technical Product Manager (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

You are a technically fluent, execution-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and stakeholder management. You communicate clearly, operate independently, and bring empathy to every interaction.

You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.

You feel comfortable owning a product backlog, onboarding API partners, presenting to a Change Advisory Board, and collaborating directly with clients to troubleshoot issues. You connect teams, drive accountability, and ensure initiatives move forward successfully.

Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Strong fluency in Agile and Scrum, including backlog ownership, sprint ceremonies, user story writing, and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, champion quality, and drive the Definition of Done.
  • Proven ability to act as a liaison between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, translating business requirements into technical language for audiences at all levels.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and authentication concepts, including error handling, log review, and defect triage.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, issue tracking, and release coordination.
  • Strong documentation skills covering requirements, epics, user stories, workflows, and integration touchpoints.
  • Active user of AI tools and copilots, with a practical focus on improving workflows and engineering productivity.
  • Highly self-managed, with strong ownership and proactive risk identification across concurrent initiatives.
  • Strong empathy and curiosity for customer and partner problems, with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria aligned with business needs.
  • Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team’s single point of accountability for quality and progress.
  • Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners.
  • Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
  • Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests.
  • Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers.
  • Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
  • Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.

Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues.
  • Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.
